title: Krutrim LLM: Multilingual Foundational Model for over a Billion People

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on a suite of Indic language benchmarks (e.g., IndicCOPA, IndicQA, IndicSentiment) and human preference scores (Mean Opinion Score) to measure the mitigation of Western-centric linguistic and cultural biases present in standard LLMs.

Qualitative analysis of the model's generated responses to culturally sensitive queries (e.g., explaining religious or cultural practices) to ensure the outputs remain neutral and do not favor any specific religion or caste.

Qualitative evaluation of the model's factual accuracy and hallucination rates when presented with adversarial or factually incorrect questions, mitigated through specific Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).
